additional_info.subject: RE: ID0477629-DC/Si-D/FR- [Y2 / R9 313202799092] The door position switch isn't functioning CRM:03289000519
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I hope you’re doing well too. Thank you for your feedback.
The problem with the door position switch is that, as it doesn’t work, the technician has blocked the switch in the “ON” position. It means that when the back door is opened, the door position switch will stay in the “ON” position.
That’s why we can’t see the issue on the error flags.
I don’t have any photo.
I hope you understand the problem now. My description of the issue was not clear, sorry for that.
Best regards,
Nathan STERN
